auditReport.title: Section 4: Financial & Revenue Operations (RevOps) Production Readiness Audit

strengths: Comprehensive multi-provider payment support (Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave, Apple IAP, Google Play)
Robust webhook handling with retry logic and idempotency
Well-designed subscription lifecycle management with grace periods
Complete dynamic pricing system with regional, promotional, and personalized pricing
Full proration support for mid-cycle upgrades
criticalGaps: No end-to-end reconciliation service between app state, payment providers, and accounting
Missing tax calculation/VAT handling by region
No revenue recognition rules or deferred revenue tracking
No monthly close process or accounting integration
No multi-currency conversion at transaction time
Missing revenue leakage monitoring and alerts

findings: No reconciliation service exists between app subscription state and payment provider records
No automated comparison of Stripe/Paystack/Flutterwave records with internal database
No scheduled reconciliation jobs or alerts for discrepancies
Transaction records stored in database but not cross-validated with provider ledgers

evidence.observation: No ReconciliationService or similar exists. Webhooks update internal state but no periodic reconciliation.

recommendations: Implement ReconciliationService with daily scheduled runs
Create reconciliation reports comparing: (1) internal subscription_states, (2) Stripe/Paystack/Flutterwave subscriptions, (3) expected revenue
Set up alerts for discrepancies > $100 or > 1% of daily volume
Add reconciliation dashboard for finance team

findings: Refund processing implemented for Stripe via processRefund() method
Dispute handling via handleDisputeCreated() with logging and status update
Flutterwave and Paystack refund webhooks handled
MISSING: No automated evidence collection for disputes
MISSING: No dispute response workflow
MISSING: No chargeback rate monitoring

evidence.codeSnippet: async handleDisputeCreated(dispute: Stripe.Dispute): Promise<void> { logger.error(`Dispute created: ${dispute.id} for charge: ${dispute.charge}`); ... }

recommendations: Implement DisputeResponseService with evidence template generation
Add dispute analytics dashboard tracking chargeback rates by user segment
Create automated evidence package (transaction logs, user activity, delivery proof)
Set up alerts when chargeback rate exceeds 0.5%

findings: No tax calculation logic found in payment service
No VAT/GST handling for EU, UK, Australia, or other jurisdictions
Regional pricing exists but focuses on purchasing power parity, not tax compliance
Currency symbols mapped in dynamic-pricing.types.ts but no tax rates
Stripe Tax integration not configured

evidence.observation: CURRENCY_SYMBOLS and regional pricing exist but no TAX_RATES or tax calculation functions

recommendations: Integrate Stripe Tax or implement TaxCalculationService
Define tax rates by country/region (EU VAT, US state sales tax, etc.)
Store tax amounts on transactions for reporting
Generate tax invoices compliant with local regulations
Consider using tax automation providers (TaxJar, Avalara)

findings: updateSubscriptionTier() uses proration_behavior: 'always_invoice'
Immediate invoice generation for upgrade difference
Test coverage for basic to premium and premium to elite upgrades
Downgrade to free tier implemented on subscription cancellation/deletion
MISSING: Prorated credits for mid-cycle downgrades to lower paid tiers
MISSING: UI/API for selecting downgrade effective date

evidence.observation: // Downgrade user to free tier - only handles full cancellation, not tier-to-tier downgrade

findings: Proration enabled via Stripe's 'always_invoice' behavior
Works correctly for upgrades
Multi-month billing cycles (3-month, 6-month) supported in schema
MISSING: Custom proration calculations for non-Stripe providers
3-day grace period configured for failed payments
handleInvoicePaymentFailed() triggers grace_period status
User notifications sent on payment failure
Automatic downgrade to free after grace period expires
Retry logic in webhook-retry.service.ts with exponential backoff
No dedicated revenue leakage detection
No alerts for: expired trials not converting, failed renewals, abandoned carts
No tracking of subscription value loss from cancellations
Webhook statistics available but not tied to revenue metrics

evidence.observation: getWebhookStats() tracks processing status but not revenue impact

recommendations: Implement RevenueLeakageMonitor with metrics for: failed renewals $, expired trials $, cancellation value $
Daily revenue reconciliation report
Alert thresholds for abnormal churn or payment failure rates
Integrate with analytics service for cohort-based revenue tracking

findings: No ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliant revenue recognition
Subscription revenue recorded at payment time, not over service period
No deferred revenue tracking for prepaid annual/multi-month subscriptions
No distinction between recognized and deferred revenue in database schema

evidence.observation: transactions table has amount and processed_at but no recognized_amount, deferred_amount, or recognition_schedule columns

recommendations: Add revenue recognition tables: deferred_revenue, revenue_recognition_schedule, recognized_revenue
Implement daily revenue recognition job
Generate revenue waterfall reports for finance
Support configurable recognition rules (point-in-time vs. over-time)

findings: No month-end close workflow
No period locking to prevent retroactive changes
No accrual calculations for partially served subscriptions
No journal entry generation for accounting systems
recommendations: Implement MonthlyCloseService with: period locking, accrual calculations, reconciliation checkpoints
Generate GL-ready reports in standard format
Create close checklist workflow for finance team
Add audit trail for any period adjustments

findings: Good: pricing_audit_log table captures pricing decisions
Good: stripe_webhook_events tracks all payment events with payloads
Good: transactions table records all payment activities
MISSING: User-initiated action audit (who changed what, when)
MISSING: Admin override audit trail
MISSING: Immutable audit log (current tables are mutable)

evidence.observation: pricing_audit_log table exists with action tracking

recommendations: Add admin_audit_log for manual changes
Implement append-only audit tables or use event sourcing
Add performedBy field to all state changes
Integrate with SIEM for security monitoring

findings: Currency field exists on transactions table
Regional pricing supports multiple currencies with symbols
MISSING: Exchange rate tracking at transaction time
MISSING: Currency conversion for reporting (everything to base currency)
MISSING: Historical exchange rate storage
Flutterwave/Paystack use local currencies (NGN, GHS) but no conversion to USD for consolidated reporting
recommendations: Add exchange_rate column to transactions table
Store amount_in_base_currency for consolidated reporting
Integrate exchange rate API for daily rates
Generate multi-currency P&L reports with conversion

findings: Application is B2C dating platform, not multi-tenant B2B
Cost allocation per tenant not applicable
Per-product cost tracking could be useful for P&L by subscription tier
recommendations: Consider implementing cost tracking by: subscription tier, acquisition channel, user cohort
Track payment provider fees per transaction for margin analysis

features: Subscription validation via Android Publisher API
Regional pricing with purchasing power parity
Personalized pricing based on engagement and behavior
A/B testing experiments for price optimization

implemented: Subscription lifecycle tests (create, upgrade, cancel, reactivate)
Webhook controller tests including dispute handling
missing: Integration tests with real payment providers (sandbox)

pciDss.notes: PCI compliance delegated to payment providers (Stripe, Paystack, Flutterwave). No card data stored locally.

gdpr.notes: Payment data includes PII. Need to ensure data retention policies and deletion capabilities.

asc606.notes: Revenue recognition not compliant with ASC 606. Critical for US GAAP reporting.

ifrs15.notes: Revenue recognition not compliant with IFRS 15. Critical for international reporting.
